name: Sid Jacobson JCC Mah Jongg
description: Sid Jacobson JCC (East Hills, Long Island) runs 8-session Beginner Mah Jongg classes and a Thursday Mah Jongg Clinic; fall 2026 classes are listed as full. Quote from the JCC page: "The 2026 National Mah Jongg League card is required and may be purchased at the first class for $15." Also lists Members Only Open Play Mondays 12:30-2:30pm (Sep 14 2026 - Jun 28 2027).
address: Sid Jacobson JCC, East Hills, NY
schedule: Beginner: Mon Oct 19-Dec 14 2026 10am-12:30pm; Tue Oct 13-Dec 8 2026 7-9:30pm; Thu Oct 15-Dec 10 2026 4-6:30pm; Clinic Thu 10am-12:30pm. Member $225 / nonmember $300 per 8-session class (full).

name: Salmagundi Club Mahjong Club
description: Weekly Thursday morning mahjong at the Salmagundi Club in Greenwich Village. Quote from the club page: "join us for American-style mahjong at Salmagundi!" Players must bring their own official National Mah Jongg League card; RSVP required so enough sets and tables can be prepared.
address: Salmagundi Club, 47 Fifth Avenue, New York, NY 10003
schedule: Every Thursday 11:00 AM-1:00 PM; $10 general admission; RSVP required

name: 92NY Mah Jongg
description: 92NY (Upper East Side) lists a "Mah jongg For Beginners" class and "Mah Jongg Supervised Play" for those who have taken the beginner class. The pages did not load for me so dates, times and American/NMJL wording are unconfirmed. 92NY also hosted an NMJL 2026 card-release event on April 8 2026.
